answer: An empty video's Design tab at 459.3 wide, 1/2/9/10. Background is Add fill, 36 by 36. Stroke is No, Solid, Dashed, each 56.7 by 38. Corner has Uniform and Individual, 41 by 38, and an 88 by 44 field at 0px. Add fill opens the colours beside the panel at once and adds a Padding row, 6% and 6%; pressing the Design tab closes the colours. White on .intrinsic, .sqs-block and .intrinsic 317.8, the placeholder 27.6 in, 404.2 by 262.7, rows stay 8. Corner 0 with a stroke or a fill shows no note (screenshots). Preview keeps the placeholder.
